decision: At p=5, the stated Pan interface applies to the constructed r5 once the identified representation and de Rham inputs hold. There is no additional residual-image condition. The inspected primary theorem is author v2, corroborated by the official published Calegari formulation.

nine_obligations.name: source_hypotheses
nine_obligations.required: A continuous irreducible odd two-dimensional representation of G_Q, finitely ramified, potentially semistable at p and with distinct Hodge–Tate weights.
nine_obligations.constructed: r5 is the multiplicity summand of the corrected QM Tate representation. Its support is T union {5}, its weights are {0,-1}, and de Rham comparison plus Berger gives potential semistability.
nine_obligations.why_match: This is exactly Conjecture 1.0.1 plus Theorem 1.0.4. De Rhamness is a separate dependency, not a consequence merely of the weights.

nine_obligations.name: constructed_objects
nine_obligations.required: An honest G_Q representation over a finite coefficient extension, rather than a projective action.
nine_obligations.constructed: The scalar-corrected rho_l uses beta or b, a_sigma and mu_sigma. A finite coefficient field contains these data and splits B; matrix units give rho_l = r_l direct-sum r_l.
nine_obligations.why_match: The sign-cocycle identity removes projectivity. Added scalars have trivial Galois action. The multiplicity summand is genuinely two-dimensional.

nine_obligations.name: domain_index_coverage
nine_obligations.required: The actual chosen prime and all coefficient realizations used downstream must lie in their stated domains.
nine_obligations.constructed: Pan is invoked only at 5. The realization r3 is subsequently obtained from the same algebraic Frobenius-trace system.
nine_obligations.why_match: There is no invocation of Pan at 3, so its extra p=3 residual restriction is irrelevant. A uniform coefficient-field degree is not assumed.

nine_obligations.name: transition_comparison_maps
nine_obligations.required: Scalar correction, restriction over a finite extension, modular twisting and Tate/cohomological comparison.
nine_obligations.constructed: Over G_Lprime the corrected rho is the actual Tate action. The modularity conclusion for r5 is up to character twist. Weight comparison and a separate finite-image argument remove that twist.
nine_obligations.why_match: The level route uses the determinant-square argument, while the baseline invokes Conrad. Duality preserves the conductor, but the duality step remains explicit.

nine_obligations.name: identity_of_consumed_object
nine_obligations.required: The representation must belong to the actual QM surface and match the downstream J1(N) constituent.
nine_obligations.constructed: The non-CM hypothesis is the exact equality End_geo^0(A)=B. The restricted multiplicity representation has scalar commutant and is absolutely irreducible.
nine_obligations.why_match: An unrelated modular family or unlabeled finite cover is not substituted. Construction of the particular geometric surface remains a separate dependency.

nine_obligations.name: coefficients_normalizations
nine_obligations.required: Hodge–Tate, reciprocity, coefficient and character-twist conventions must agree.
nine_obligations.constructed: The cyclotomic weight is -1. The Tate weights are {0,-1}; the modular weights are {0,1-k}. Added coefficients are constant.
nine_obligations.why_match: Pan page 7 matches this convention. The weight difference forces k=2. Frobenius, duality and local normalization comparisons are separately retained.

nine_obligations.name: local_conditions
nine_obligations.required: Potential semistability at 5, oddness at infinity and finite ramification.
nine_obligations.constructed: Proper-smooth comparison, direct summands and finite descent give de Rhamness; Berger supplies potential semistability. Corrected conjugation exchanges Hodge summands and has square one.
nine_obligations.why_match: These are conditions on r5 itself. Neither residual oddness nor Hodge–Tate weights alone is substituted. The independent de Rham review remains separate.

nine_obligations.name: exceptional_cases
nine_obligations.required: CM fibers, small primes, residual exceptions and finite character twisting must be handled.
nine_obligations.constructed: The CM case is separate. The chosen prime is 5, and r3 is not another Pan application. The finite twist may have unbounded order.
nine_obligations.why_match: No residual-image exception occurs at 5. Weight zero alone is not used to infer finite image: the level-route determinant calculation supplies that step.

nine_obligations.name: downstream_consumption
nine_obligations.required: The exact conclusion required by the modular-height consumer.
nine_obligations.constructed: A weight-two newform gives a modular Tate constituent. Compatible realizations, Carayol and Casselman, then Faltings and Poincare give the conductor and the isogeny A times Z to J1(N).
nine_obligations.why_match: Pan supplies modularity up to twist only. Conductor estimates, coefficient-field bounds, global PEL/contact identity and the final sourceArithmetic statement are not consequences of this bounded review.
